source: Lunch break’s over. After a relaxing stop beside the River Thames, it’s time to get back to work. Make your way back along the famous Marlow Donkey path, following the river towards Bourne End. A service is waiting there for you to take over, so head down the line, enjoy the scenery, and get ready to continue your shift.
target: 午休结束了。在泰晤士河畔度过一段轻松的时光后，是时候回去工作了。沿着著名的马洛铁驴小径往回走，沿着河流前往伯恩安德。那儿有一班列车正等待你接班，所以请沿铁路线前行，欣赏沿途的风景，准备继续你的班次。

source: A distinctive part of the Henley Royal Regatta is its tradition of dress.Visitors and competitors alike often arrive in formal attire, with many wearing brightly coloured blazers that represent their rowing clubs.These striking jackets, each with their own unique patterns and colours, add to the regatta’s unmistakable atmosphere along the riverbank.
target: 亨利皇家赛艇会的一个鲜明特色是其着装传统。游客和参赛者往往都会穿着正式服装，许多人会穿着代表其赛艇俱乐部的鲜艳西装外套。这些引人注目的夹克各具独特的图案和颜色，为河岸边增添了赛艇会独一无二的氛围。

source: A failed train has brought services on the Windsor branch to a halt. Take a spare Class 165 from Slough to assist a stranded unit near Windsor & Eton Central, couple up, and tow it safely back to Slough. With the branch blocked and passengers waiting, a steady hand will be needed to restore normal service.
target: 一列故障列车导致温莎支线的运营中断。驾驶一列空闲的165型动车组从斯劳出发，去救援一列滞留在温莎与伊顿中央附近的受困列车，与其重联并安全拖回斯劳。由于支线受阻且旅客在等待，你需要沉着应对以恢复正常运营。

source: A royal wedding at Windsor Castle has drawn huge crowds from across the country. Operate the busy shuttle between Slough and Windsor & Eton Central with a Class 165, keeping services running smoothly as thousands of visitors travel to witness the celebrations. With packed platforms and tight turnarounds, careful driving will be essential on this historic day.
target: 温莎城堡的一场皇家婚礼吸引了来自全国各地的庞大人群。驾驶165型动车组运营斯劳与温莎与伊顿中央之间的繁忙穿梭车次，在数以千计的游客前往见证婚礼之际，保持服务顺畅运行。面对拥挤的站台和紧张的周转时间，在这个具有历史意义的日子里，小心驾驶至关重要。

source: After enjoying your lunch break by the River Thames, it’s time to get back to work. Walk to Bourne End station to take over a waiting Class 165 and operate the branch shuttle towards Marlow. With the quiet afternoon service about to depart, prepare the train and keep the traditional “Marlow Donkey” running on time.
target: 在泰晤士河畔享用完午餐后，该回去工作了。步行至伯恩安德站，接管一列等待中的165型动车组，并运营前往马洛的支线穿梭列车。在这趟安静的下午车次即将出发之际，整备好列车，让传统的“马洛铁驴”服务保持准点运行。

source: And that brings us to the end of today’s duties. From the quiet charm of the Marlow branch to the run back towards Maidenhead, you’ve successfully completed the Marlow Donkey service. Well done.
target: 今天的任务到此结束。从充满静谧魅力的马洛支线到返回梅登黑德的行程，你已成功完成了马洛铁驴服务。干得漂亮。

source: Bourne End was once a through station, with the line continuing onward towards High Wycombe. Today, it remains a two-platform station, but its layout tells a different story. Only Platform 1 provides access to the Marlow branch, and due to its short length, services here are limited to just two-car trains. Beyond the station lies the charming single-line stretch to Marlow, affectionately known as the Marlow Donkey. The name dates back to the days of steam, when a small locomotive worked this quiet branch. The legacy lives on today, not just on the railway, but in the town itself, where the Marlow Donkey pub stands as a reminder of the line’s history.
target: 伯恩安德曾经是一个通过式车站，线路一直延伸到高威科姆。如今，它仍然是一个双站台车站，但其布局已经截然不同。只有1号站台通往马洛支线，由于其长度较短，这里的列车服务仅限于两节编组的列车。车站之外便是通往马洛、被亲切地称为“马洛铁驴”的迷人单线区间。这个名字可以追溯到蒸汽时代，当时一辆小型机车在这条安静的支线上工作。这一遗产在今天依然存在，不仅在铁路上，而且在镇上也是如此，那里的“马洛铁驴”（Marlow Donkey）酒吧默默诉说着这条线路的历史。
